subject: Last Year's GSOC and The John Chambers Award

messages.author: 267c7c6c510dc8a2
messages.subject: Last Year's GSOC and The John Chambers Award
parts:
Hi All,

As we start ramping up for this year's GSOC, I thought that I'd let everyone know that last year's ggplot2 Plot Builder project has been selected to receive the John M. Chambers Statistical Software Award. The plot builder is a piece of software that simply wouldn't have been built except for the funding from Google.

Best,
Ian
